full_judgment: 40. On the other hand Mr ATM Mizanur Rahman, learned Advocate appears for the accused and submits that 13 witnesses out of 40 were examined in the present case and non-examination of such huge number of witnesses raises a presumption against the prosecution case. He also submits that Constable Shamser Ali (CS witness No. 37) who identified the dead body to the Doctor (PW 12) and the recording officer of the case were also withheld. Though they are formal witnesses, their evidence were essential for proof of identification of the dead body as well as for proof of the fact of recording the case. Mr Rahman also assails the confessions contending that while the Magistrate recorded their confessions both the accused were in the same room and it was a serious illegality. He also submits that accused Abdul Hakim claimed himself to be a minor and his trial along with an adult is an illegality, which vitiated the whole trial.
